title_en: Apartment 2+1+2 with two balconies for sale in JORDAN MISJA Street, Tirana €221,000
description_en: Apartment 2+1+2 for sale. It is bordered by JORDAN MISJA Street and BULEVARDI I RI. In one of the most developed areas in Tirana. Quick access to the main connecting roads. Apartment data: Typology: 2+1+2 and 2 balconies with South-East and North orientation. Total area: 104 m² Net area: 89 m² Functional layout and natural lighting. - Built in 2008. - Organized with 4 apartments on each floor - Building equipped with an elevator. The apartment is ideal for both family living and investment, thanks to the continuous urban development and the continuous increase in the value of the area.
